words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun that continues and restrictively qualifies the known group from 29:58
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) opens the ayah as a dependent relative phrase, so the reader must look back to the rewarded group in 29:58 rather than treat 29:59 as a fresh, isolated sentence. The pronoun then filters that prior group through two predicates: completed patience and ongoing reliance. Its nominative form leaves the appositional-versus-adjectival attachment open, but both options keep the same prior antecedent in view and make the ayah a boundary-binding character profile.

topics.headline: dependent relative routes the reader backward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by continuing the promise of 29:58, not by introducing a new group.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar and clause evidence identify an ayah-initial relative phrase whose antecedent lies outside the ayah.

topics.headline: one qualifier holds two defining predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that patience and reliance together specify the prior reward recipients, while the exact apposition-or-attribute label need not be forced.
topics.reason: The relative clause contains both predicates under one pronoun; rows about badal and naʿt are preserved as compatible parses without selecting one as mandatory.

words.gloss_range: completed, subject-held endurance without an explicit object; active restraint under pressure rather than passive waiting
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes enduring, restraining, holding firm, and concrete bitterness or binding images; the local perfect Form I selects ethical endurance while preserving felt restraint
words.prose: {{ar:صَبَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:ṣabarū}}) gives the first defining predicate as a completed, objectless act: the people are marked by endurance already proven, without naming a single hardship as its limit. The root imagery of restraint, holding together, and bitter preservation gives that patience a load-bearing texture, while local Form I keeps the sense simple and subject-owned rather than causative, reciprocal, or forced by a derived stem. As a finite perfect verb rather than an active-participle label, this completed endurance stands before the coordinated reliance, and the same patience-and-trust pattern is echoed at 16:42 while the same surah's testing frame at 29:3 lets patience read as the visible proof of sincerity.

topics.headline: perfect objectless endurance defines the subjects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patience is presented as an accomplished quality of the people, not as endurance over one named trial.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect Form I, masculine plural, and intransitive here, with no explicit object.

topics.headline: root imagery gives patience held pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels patience as maintained self-restraint under pressure, while the local verb still means ethical endurance.
topics.reason: The lexical family supports bitterness, restraint, and holding imagery, but local Form I verbal context selects endurance rather than a concrete plant or object.

topics.headline: simple finite verb precedes ongoing reliance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah first names achieved endurance, then moves through coordination toward continuing reliance.
topics.reason: The first predicate is complete before the conjunction, and the next predicate is imperfect, creating a local aspect contrast.

topics.headline: patience joins a recognized trust profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this patience as part of a recurring patience-and-reliance profile and as the answer to the surah's earlier testing theme.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete links to the same formula at 16:42 and the same-surah testing frame at 29:3.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction binding the reliance predicate to the completed patience predicate within one relative clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge that keeps the second predicate inside the same relative clause. It binds the reliance phrase to completed patience without restarting the sentence, so the same group is defined by both traits. Because it is attached directly to the following fronted preposition, the second beat begins as a fused continuation, and the light conjunction moves audibly into the next word's guttural onset; its order after the perfect verb lets equality of coordination carry developmental pressure from proven endurance into ongoing dependence.

topics.headline: coordination keeps both predicates on one group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patience and reliance describe the same antecedent group, not two groups or a restarted sentence.
topics.reason: The conjunction is classified as coordinating and the attachment evidence joins the two predicates inside one relative clause.

topics.headline: bound conjunction launches the fronted reliance phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the second predicate as a connected handoff from endurance into reliance, while grammar remains coordination rather than a separate circumstantial clause.
topics.reason: The written bound conjunction and following prepositional phrase support fused continuation; the possible circumstantial shade is limited by the local coordination evidence.

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) opens the reliance phrase before the verb appears, placing the support of trust in the reader's path first. In this construction the preposition governs {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) as the object of reliance for {{ar:يَتَوَكَّلُونَ}} ({{tr:yatawakkalūna}}), so its broad values are narrowed to dependence and weight-bearing support, not simple location or a duty imposed on the Lord. The fronting gives strong focus and restriction-pressure to the support phrase; that pressure is real, though the guardrail evidence licenses emphasis more securely than an absolute exclusivity claim. Its long final vowel slows the entry into the support noun, and the same reliance pattern is visible in 11:56 and 14:12.

topics.headline: preposition marks support for trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees reliance as weight placed upon a support, while obligation, location, and motion senses are not selected locally.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the Lord-phrase and is attached to the reliance verb, narrowing the preposition's broad range to the reliance complement frame.

topics.headline: fronted support phrase focuses reliance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader processes the support of reliance before the act of relying, creating focus and restriction-pressure without needing to overstate the syntax as absolute exclusivity.
topics.reason: The phrase is fronted before the verb; QAC and translation support identify emphasis, while the strongest exclusivity language is kept qualified.

topics.headline: the long preposition opens a familiar formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reliance phrase begin with an elongated preposition and recognizes the support-plus-trust formula seen elsewhere.
topics.reason: The spelling and cadence rows are locally compatible, and the formula row supplies concrete parallels at 11:56 and 14:12.

words.gloss_range: their Lord as a definite possessive support within the fronted reliance phrase; singular Lord related to the plural group
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes lordship, ownership, mastery, sustaining, nurturing, governance, and rearing to completion; local noun selects the Lord as the reliable sustaining authority
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) is not a generic title floating in the clause: the possessive construct makes the Lord-relation definite, personal to the group, and genitively governed by the fronted preposition. Its singular head with a plural suffix concentrates many subjects onto one shared support. The root range adds sustaining governance, nurture, ownership, and authority, so the one trusted is both caring and able to dispose of the affair; the local trust construction selects that support role rather than every branch of the family. The word also carries the people of 29:58 forward through its suffix, echoes the individual Lord-relation of 29:26 in a collective form, and belongs to the recurring reliance formula seen in 11:56 and 14:12. In its pre-verbal hinge position, the doubled bāʾ gives the support noun a compressed acoustic pressure rather than only a syntactic role.

topics.headline: possessive construct makes the support personal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reliance is placed on their own Lord, with title and relationship compressed into one definite construct.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition and bears a possessive suffix that resolves back to the described group.

topics.headline: one Lord supports the plural group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a plural group gathered into one shared Lord-relation rather than scattered among separate supports.
topics.reason: The singular noun and plural possessive suffix are both visible in the local form, and the suffix carries the prior group forward.

topics.headline: nurture and authority underwrite reliance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the support of trust as sustaining and authoritative, while the local noun remains the Lord in a reliance clause rather than an unrestricted lexical survey.
topics.reason: The root family supports nurture, rearing, governance, ownership, and mastery; local syntax selects the Lord as the semantic support of reliance.

topics.headline: same-surah and cross-surah reliance links
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this possessive Lord-phrase as part of a larger pattern: personal Lord-relation becomes the shared object of reliance.
topics.reason: The rows supply same-surah links at 29:10, 29:26, 29:30, and 29:50, plus reliance-formula parallels at 11:56 and 14:12.

topics.headline: support noun sits at the hinge of reliance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader meets the sustaining support before the reliance verb, with the central noun carrying both structural and acoustic weight.
topics.reason: The noun stands inside the fronted prepositional phrase between the preposition and the delayed reliance verb.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form V self-entrusting reliance, governed by a fronted support phrase and left open without a named entrusted affair
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes entrusting, appointing an agent, relying, delegating affairs, and trustee language; local Form V with the support preposition selects active self-entrustment and reliance
words.prose: {{ar:يَتَوَكَّلُونَ}} ({{tr:yatawakkalūna}}) closes the ayah with imperfect, ongoing reliance, so the final sound does not leave the reader at completed endurance but at continuing dependence. The Form V shape makes the subjects active in placing themselves into trust, while the omitted entrusted affair generalizes the reliance beyond a single stated matter. Its fronted support phrase directs that reliance onto their Lord before the verb arrives; this creates strong focus and support-directed restriction, though the absolute exclusivity claim is safer as qualified emphasis. The plural ending keeps the same relative group as the actors, and the verb completes the two-beat profile of patience plus trust, a formula visible at 16:42 and in reliance scenes such as 11:56 and 14:12; after the settlement promise of 29:58, this final verb names the human posture toward the promised support.

topics.headline: final imperfect leaves reliance ongoing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on continuing reliance, not on a completed one-time act.
topics.reason: The local verb is imperfect and final, contrasting with the earlier perfect patience predicate.

topics.headline: Form V makes trust self-entrusting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees reliance as an active self-entrusting posture, not vague confidence or merely appointing someone else.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the verb as Form V/reflexive, and the lexical family supports entrusting and delegation.

topics.headline: objectless trust rests on a fronted support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no specific affair is named; reliance is generalized and focused toward the preposed Lord-phrase.
topics.reason: The verb has no direct object and is governed with a fronted prepositional complement; exclusivity language is qualified to focus and restriction-pressure.

topics.headline: plural ending completes the shared profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same plural group carrying both predicates, with sound and grammar pairing patience and reliance while keeping their aspects distinct.
topics.reason: The masculine plural ending agrees with the relative group and matches the earlier plural predicate while the imperfect aspect differs.

topics.headline: reliance answers promise and joins a formula

topics.reason: The rows give formula parallels at 16:42, 11:56, and 14:12 and boundary links with the settlement promise in 29:58.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordination of صَبَرُوا with وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ joins completed endurance to ongoing reliance directed specifically upon their Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: Self-restraint keeps the agent from collapse or panic, while entrusting the affair transfers management of what exceeds the agent to a Lord characterized by ownership, repair, and sufficient guardianship. The two acts divide responsibility rather than cancel human agency.

activation_trace.role: Restraint of the self against panic supplies the active discipline of endurance.
Progressive repair and nurture make the Lord the one who can carry an affair toward completion.
Deliberate assignment of an affair supplies the transfer of management beyond the agent's reach.
The sufficient keeper supplies the competent receiving side of that transfer.

changed_reading.before: They patiently tolerate difficulty and generally trust God.
changed_reading.after: They actively govern their own response while assigning the unmanageable remainder to their repairing and sufficient Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: صَبَرُوا can retain the pressure-image of an ordeal with no outlet, while عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ locates what bears them during it.
baseline_models.mechanism: When circumstances present no visible exit, endurance is the refusal to let enclosure dictate allegiance. Reliance relocates the person's support from the closed circumstance to the sovereign Lord, so remaining held is not the same as being abandoned.

activation_trace.role: An inescapable severity supplies the pressure-container in which endurance is exercised.
Sovereignty and ownership place the Lord outside and above the enclosing pressure.
Reliant support supplies stability when no route can yet be seen.

changed_reading.before: Patience is a calm temperament in ordinary adversity.
changed_reading.after: Patience is allegiance maintained inside a no-exit pressure, because the person's actual support is the sovereign Lord rather than the visible enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens by treating professed faith as material subjected to assay, then shows social pressure capable of tilting allegiance and strenuous effort expended by the self. Against that field, صبر is the control that prevents pressure from rewriting loyalty, and tawakkul identifies the support that makes this control sustainable.

activation_trace.role: The assay of metal or person turns verbal profession into something tested for revealed quality.
Pressure that inclines away from truth supplies the concrete failure that endurance resists.
Expenditure of capacity under hardship makes faithful agency effortful rather than merely verbal.
Self-restraint supplies the control that keeps an assay from becoming defection.
Reliance supplies durable support for allegiance under repeated pressure.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 places testing before the disclosure of truthfulness and falsehood.
29:8 and 29:10 locate pressure inside kinship and crowd relations, not only impersonal calamity.
29:59 coordinates a completed endurance clause with an ongoing reliance clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, social deflection, strenuous agency, restraint, and reliance; I infer that restraint preserves allegiance while reliance stabilizes it. A live alternative is the broader reading of endurance under hardship without a specifically allegiance-testing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse praises people who withstand generic hardship.
changed_reading.after: The verse identifies people whose allegiance survives assay: they restrain the pressure-induced turn and keep their support assigned to their Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context stretches action across incompatible clocks: an appointed term is coming, Noah remains for an immense duration, opponents demand acceleration, arrival can be sudden, and the promised lodging is enduring. Patience therefore manages conduct across opaque duration, while tawakkul assigns control of the schedule to the Lord.

activation_trace.role: A bounded appointed term supplies a real endpoint whose date the agent does not control.
Prolonged remaining in place supplies the long scale on which fidelity must continue.
Demanded acceleration supplies the temptation to force the timetable.
The fixed term blocks acceleration without making arrival unreal.
Sudden arrival makes readiness, rather than prediction, the agent's temporal task.
Durable continuance supplies the long-term destination beyond the unstable wait.
Self-restraint keeps conduct steady when timing is unavailable.
Entrusting the affair includes relinquishing control of its timetable.

structural_cues: 29:5 announces a coming term, while 29:14 supplies the surah's extreme image of prolonged fidelity.
29:53 juxtaposes attempted acceleration, a specified term, and sudden arrival.
29:58 places stable continuance immediately before the focus qualification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies long remaining, fixed termini, haste, surprise, and permanence; I infer that the delegated affair includes timing and that sabr is temporal discipline. A live alternative is that these time cues concern separate episodes rather than one patience mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Patience means tolerating pain until it stops.
changed_reading.after: Patience means sustaining right action across an unreadable schedule, while reliance entrusts both the endpoint and its timing to the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes two loads. Deceivers cannot take over another person's moral liability, yet the creature immediately after the focus does not transport its own provision as cargo because God allots it. Sabr carries the nondelegable work of faithful response; tawakkul delegates provision-management without delegating accountability.

activation_trace.role: The denied promise to bear liability establishes moral burden as nontransferable.
Actual bearing of accumulated liability confirms that each agent remains answerable for carried wrongdoing.
Visible cargo-bearing supplies the contrasting load that the creature does not transport.
Allotted giving identifies provision as received distribution rather than self-secured freight.
Disciplined endurance carries the agent's own faithful response.
Delegation assigns provision-management to another without transferring moral agency.
The sufficient keeper explains why release of the provision-load is not neglect.

structural_cues: 29:12-13 explicitly negates one person's proposed transfer of another's sins and then assigns real burdens.
29:60 immediately follows the focus with a creature that does not carry its provision, followed by God's provision of it and the audience.
The repeated ح م ل vocabulary makes the contrast a load-allocation mechanism rather than a loose theme of trust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nontransferable liability, non-carried provision, allotted sustenance, endurance, and delegation; I infer a boundary between accountable action and provision-control. A live alternative is that the two carrying scenes are independent warnings and consolations.

changed_reading.before: Reliance means handing every concern over and ceasing to carry anything.
changed_reading.after: The patient agent carries the nondelegable burden of faithful action but refuses to carry provision as self-owned cargo, assigning that distribution to the sufficient Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Departure from one dwelling toward the Lord opens onto wide terrain and culminates in lodging assigned by another in elevated, lasting rooms. The sequence turns patience from static staying into continuity through severance, transit, and re-placement; reliance allows the mover to relinquish control of the destination without becoming motionless.

activation_trace.role: Exit from one abode to another supplies the decisive movement away from a constricting habitat.
The Lord as progressive caretaker makes the migration directional and capable of a new completion.
Spatial release from constriction supplies traversable room beyond the present site.
An abode assigned by another supplies re-placement after departure.
Upper rooms give the assigned destination concrete built form.
Stable continuance turns temporary displacement into durable settlement.
Endurance preserves continuity of agency across departure and transit.
Entrusting the affair releases control of where and how final lodging is arranged.

structural_cues: 29:26 explicitly directs migration toward the Lord.
29:56 couples the wideness of God's earth with exclusive worship.
29:58 promises assigned rooms and stable dwelling immediately before 29:59 identifies the enduring, relying recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies departure, direction toward the Lord, spatial width, assigned lodging, and permanence; I infer a transit mechanism in which reliance enables movement and the Lord controls re-housing. A live alternative keeps 29:58 solely as afterlife reward and does not generalize the transit pattern.

changed_reading.before: Patience means remaining in place until conditions improve.
changed_reading.after: Patient reliance can require leaving a constricted place, crossing available space without owning the destination, and accepting re-housing arranged by the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah tests supports under changing loads: adopted managers become a structurally weak shelter, danger at sea produces exclusive dependence that evaporates after rescue, and a secure precinct remains bounded while people are snatched around it. عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ then reads as a load-bearing support choice, while ongoing tawakkul and sabr keep that choice from being merely crisis-induced.

activation_trace.role: Alternative managers who claim to stand over an affair supply the rival support system.
Shelter and dwelling give reliance a structural image that can be tested for protection.
Loss of strength marks the false shelter as unable to bear the load placed on it.
The vessel in unstable water supplies a crisis environment that exposes actual dependence.
Exclusive separation from partners describes the temporary purity of crisis-reliance.
A spatial sanctuary supplies a contrasting shelter whose security is actually maintained.
Rapid snatching around the sanctuary supplies the external load against which security is visible.
Sovereign ownership identifies the support that can genuinely stand over the affair.
Continuing reliance makes support-selection durable across danger and safety.

structural_cues: 29:41 explicitly casts adopted protectors as a house whose weakness is structural.
29:65 toggles from exclusive dependence at sea to association immediately upon rescue.
29:67 contrasts a secure bounded place with people being snatched around it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival managers, weak shelter, vessel crisis, temporary exclusivity, sanctuary, and surrounding seizure; I infer a repeated load-test of chosen support and read ongoing tawakkul as continuity across states. A live alternative treats the three scenes as separate critiques of association.

changed_reading.before: Trust is an emergency appeal made when danger becomes acute.
changed_reading.after: Trust is the durable choice of the Lord as load-bearing support before, during, and after crisis; patience prevents that choice from dissolving when safety returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context commands movement through the earth and closes with strenuous exertion followed by divinely supplied paths. Human effort therefore precedes full route-disclosure. Sabr sustains motion while the route is incomplete, and tawakkul delegates guidance of the next path rather than abandoning action.

activation_trace.role: Going forward and traversing supply active movement as a mode of learning.
Expenditure of capacity under hardship supplies effort before the promised guidance.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies direction that the agent does not manufacture alone.
Extended traversable paths give the granted guidance a practical route-form.
Self-restraint sustains effort before the whole route becomes visible.
The weak dependent who abandons his affair supplies the passive failure mode excluded by effort-before-guidance.
Proper reliance assigns route-disclosure to the Lord while the agent remains in motion.

structural_cues: 29:20 makes travel and observation an imperative rather than a passive spectacle.
29:69 places striving before the emphatic promise of guidance into paths.
The surah ends with guided plurality of paths rather than prior possession of one fully disclosed route.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commanded travel, strenuous exertion, subsequent guidance, traversable paths, and a passive-dependency failure branch; I infer an effort-guidance loop in which reliance concerns route-disclosure. A live alternative reads guidance as reward after completed striving rather than direction emerging during it.

changed_reading.before: Reliance waits for a fully known route before acting.
changed_reading.after: Patient reliance moves and exerts under partial knowledge, entrusting the Lord to disclose traversable paths as faithful effort continues.

strongest_changes: The repeated carrying vocabulary turns patience and reliance into calibrated burden allocation: accountable action remains with the person while provision is not treated as self-carried freight.
Migration, wide terrain, and assigned lasting rooms make patient reliance mobile and re-housing-oriented rather than a command simply to remain in place.
Weak shelter, crisis-only dependence, secure sanctuary, and effort followed by guidance make tawakkul a durable, active choice of support rather than emergency passivity.
Appointed, prolonged, accelerated, sudden, and permanent timescales make sabr discipline under an unreadable schedule and tawakkul delegation of timing.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet gives 29:59 unusually concrete mechanics. Its immediate frame runs from wide earth through death and return to assigned rooms, then from patient reliance to a moving creature that does not carry provision; earlier and later repetitions of burden, shelter, crisis, and path disclose how the two focus actions allocate agency.
remaining_uncertainties: The surface sequence strongly links 29:59 to the recipients and workers of 29:58, but the packet supplies no explicit syntactic parse of that relation.
The migration and re-housing mechanism can operate both within worldly displacement and across return after death; the trace preserves both scales rather than choosing one.
The split د ب ب persistence reading and the cloud-reservoir reading are intentionally branch-distant material analogies, not proposed lexical substitutions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Restraint paired with transferred reliance.** ص ب ر B001 is self-restraint from panic, while B003 includes standing surety with someone. The relative clause identifies the workers by patience and then places reliance upon their Lord. I infer that they restrain reactive flight while refusing the fantasy of self-guarantee; patience reads as held conduct sustained by an external guarantor, not passive immobility.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:60 gives reliance a concrete provisioning analogue: creatures move without carrying their sustenance. Trust is thus not abstraction but refusal to make stored provision the condition of faithful movement.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Self-restraint and reliance divide the work of endurance.** Lexical evidence: `صَبَرُوا`, root `ص ب ر`, `B001` (self-restraint from panic); `رَبِّهِم`, root `ر ب ب`, `B002` (nurture and completion); and `يَتَوَكَّلُون`, root `و ك ل`, `B002` (reliance and trust). Structural cue: the relative clause identifies the workers promised chambers in `29:58`; `29:60` then gives creatures that do not carry their provision, and `29:64` exposes distracting near-life. Assigned role: patience restrains panic-driven departure from the way; reliance hands outcome and provision to the nurturing Lord. Abductive move: I infer a division of agency: subjects govern their response, while entrusting what they cannot secure. Reading change: endurance is neither passivity nor self-sufficiency but disciplined action joined to delegated outcome.

2. **Reliance is active handing over, not incapacity.** Lexical evidence: the same root `و ك ل` also has `B001` (handing a matter over to another), while `B003` separately names an incapable dependent person. Structural cue: these people have already believed, worked, migrated, and restrained themselves before relying. Assigned role: `B001/B002` mark deliberate entrustment after action; the context excludes `B003` helplessness as the governing image. Abductive move: this distinction is inferred from the workers' demonstrated agency and the next ayah's provision example. Reading change: trust becomes a chosen transfer of control after responsible effort.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later confirmation (`29:60`, `29:69`):** Creatures that do not carry their provision validate reliance, while the closing promise to guide strivers prevents reliance from collapsing into inactivity. Patience and trust sit between motion and guidance: effort is retained, total outcome-control is handed over.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, koyulaşmış meyve özü veya yağ tortusu olan bir maddeyi ve bu maddeyle deri kap, yiyecek ya da ilacın işlenip güçlendirilmesini tutarlı biçimde bir araya getirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Maddenin kendisi ile o madde kullanılarak işlenmiş nesne ayrıdır; sahiplik ve yönetim anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan koyu öz veya tortu ile onun kullanıldığı işleme alanında kalır; benzer sesli sahiplik anlamına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Meyveden koyulaştırılmış öz ya da yağın koyu tortusudur; ayrıca deri kap, yiyecek veya ilaç bu madde sürülerek ya da katılarak işlenip güçlendirilir.

facets.statement: Temel madde koyu bir meyve özü veya yağın dibinde kalan koyu tortudur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar koyu öz ve yağ tortusu anlamını, deri kapların güçlendirilmesi ile yiyecek ve ilaçların bu maddeyle hazırlanması kullanımına bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir yere bağlanıp oradan ayrılmama çekirdeğini insan, deve ve bulut için destekler; süreklilik ve yaklaşma anlamları da kalıcılık eksenine bağlı yan gelişmelerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel sınır bir yerde kalma ve sürmedir; hareketin kendisi veya bulutun türü bu dalın çekirdeği değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yer, hayvan ve bulutla kurulan bağlı kullanımlar ayrı örnekler olarak korunur; bunlardan biri bütün dalın tek yalın anlamı yapılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde kalıp oradan ayrılmamak veya bir durumun kesilmeden sürmesidir. Hayvanın bir eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma anlamı bu kalıcılık çekirdeğinin özel uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, hayvan veya başka bir varlık bulunduğu yere bağlanır ve oradan ayrılmaz.
Bulutun ya da rüzgârın sürmesi, kalıcılığın zamansal genişlemesidir.
Hayvanın eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma, çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yerde kalma, hayvanın belli yere veya eşe bağlanması, bulut ile rüzgârın sürmesi ve yaklaşmayı kalıcılık çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yer bağlılığı ile kesintisiz devamın ortak çekirdeğini anlatan genel bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yerden ayrılmama, bağlı kalma ve süreklilik öğelerini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, birbirine binmiş ya da aşağıda asılı duran bir bulut kümesini ortak kimlik olarak destekler. Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilse de başka tanıklıklar siyah olabileceğini söylediğinden renk tanımın zorunlu öğesi değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bulutun yapısını ve konumunu anlatır; renk ile yağmur veya bitki yetiştirme sonucu zorunlu tanım öğesi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bulut kümesi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yağmurun kendisi veya yalnız yağış zamanı bu yalın anlama taşınmaz.

Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda öne çıkar, ancak renk bütün kullanımlar için sabit değildir.
Bitkiyi besleyen yağmurla ilişkilendirilmesi adlandırmanın açıklaması olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran bulut yapısında birleşir; renk konusunda beyazlık ile renk değişkenliği arasında fark bulunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, kura veya kumar oklarını bir arada tutan deri parçası, bez ya da okluk benzeri kabı tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Okların topluca kendisi de kabın bir araya getirme işlevinden doğan yakın kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: İşlem fazlasını adlandıran biçimler ile malın bu yolla artması ve kişinin böyle bir işleme girmesi ayrı gerçekleşmeler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir alışverişte veya borç ilişkisinde anaparanın üstüne eklenen, kapsamı işlemin belirli kuruluş biçimi ve kurallarıyla sınırlı fazlalıktır. Verilen borçtan daha çoğunun alınması belirgin bir gerçekleşmedir.

facets.statement: İşlemde anaparanın üstüne bir fazlalık eklenir.
Borç verenin verdiğinden daha çoğunu geri alması belirgin bir gerçekleşmedir.
Fazlalığın anlamı ve hükmü, alışveriş veya borcun belirli kuruluş biçimine bağlıdır.
Kişinin bu tür fazlalık içeren bir işleme girmesi ayrıca anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, anaparayı aşan artışı işlem alanına bağlar; borçta daha çoğunu geri alma örneğini belirginleştirirken kapsamın her artışı değil, özel biçimde kurulan fazlalığı içerdiğini gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, insan veya hayvanda yüksek ve zor solumayı ortaklaştırır. Yürüyüş veya koşu sonrasında insanın soluğunun yükselmesi ile atın koşu ya da korku sonucu şişmesi bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir. Dal bir arazi yüksekliğini değil, solunumun zorlanmış durumunu anlatır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yüksek, hızlı veya tıkanmış soluk durumuyla sınırlıdır; tek başına genel yorgunluğu ya da süreğen bir hastalık tanısını zorunlu kılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Soluk sıkışmasını adlandıran biçimler ile kişinin veya hayvanın koşu, yürüyüş ya da korku sonucu bu duruma girmesi ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya hayvanın yürüyüş ya da koşu gibi bir nedenle soluğunun yükselmesi ve zorlaşmasıdır. Atın koşu veya korku sonucu şişmesi bu solunum durumunun hayvandaki özel bir görünümüdür.

facets.statement: Soluk olağandan yüksek, hızlı ve sıkışık duruma gelir.
Durum yürüyüş veya koşu sonrasında insanı ya da hayvanı etkileyebilir; korku sonrası görünüm at için tanıklanır.
Atın koşu veya korku sonucu şişmesi zorlanan solumanın özel bir görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar yüksek ve zor solumayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir; yürüyüş veya koşu bu durumu tetikleyebilir, şişme görünümü ise atın koşu veya korku sonrasındaki özel gerçekleşmesidir.

error_profile.preserves: Soluğun hem yükselmesini hem de zorlaşıp sıkışmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yürüme veya koşma sonrasında soluğun hızlanıp zorlaştığı geçici durum için doğaldır.

error_profile.loses: Korku sonucu oluşan şişme görünümünü ve daha genel soluk tıkanmasını tam karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zorlanmış solunumun yükseklikten çok sıkışma yönünün öne çıktığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Soluğun güçleşmesi ve göğüste sıkışma duygusunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Soluğun yükselmesi ve bedenin şişer görünmesi ayrıntısını azaltır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çocuk veya ürün gibi büyüyen bir varlığı besleyerek gelişmesini sağlama ile bir topluluk içinde yetişip gelişme yönlerini aynı büyüme sürecinde birleştirir. Ettirgen bakım ile yetişenin kendi gelişimi katılımcı bakımından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Besleyip büyütme, bunun sonucu gelişme ve bir topluluk içinde yetişme kullanımları katılımcı değişimleri korunarak ayrı gösterilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar beslemeyi büyümenin nedeni, büyümeyi de bakımın sonucu olarak ilişkilendirir; çocuk ve ürün bu yapının örnekleridir, topluluk içinde yetişme ise katılımcı yönünü değiştirir.

facets.statement: Anatomik yer uyluğun gövdeye bağlandığı kök ve kasık bölgesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, işi üstlenme eylemi ile görevliyi bildiren biçimleri ayırır; ayrı ve tekil deve sahibi karşılığını dalın genel anlamına katmaz.
